cards.name: Chaser Control
cards.summary: Control panel of the 'Chasing Line - Boxes' shape preset: a group of rectangles that steps horizontally across the full comp width and wraps around, like marquee chaser lights.
use_for: animated accent line under a lower third or headline strap
looping marquee border on a 'breaking' banner
progress-style chaser on a reel title card
avoid: looks dated/cheesy on serious documentary graphics
does nothing on footage layers: it only drives the preset's shape layer

params.name: Box Step Speed
params.does: steps per second (each step moves the group one Spread); negative reverses direction, 0 parks the boxes mid-frame

params.name: Size
params.does: [width, height] in pixels of each box: drives the Rectangle Size of Group 1

params.name: Spread
params.does: horizontal spacing between boxes (feeds Repeater 1 position x)
params.typical: 120-200 (preset 150); keep it larger than the box width or boxes overlap

params.name: Elements
params.does: number of boxes in the moving group (Repeater 1 Copies)

cards.scripting: Pseudo effect (expression-control panel) defined in Support Files/PresetEffects.xml; it renders NOTHING by itself. Apply C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe After Effects 2026/Support Files/Presets/Shapes/Elements/Chasing Line - Boxes.ffx to an empty shape layer (layer.applyPreset(File(...))); it adds Group 1 (a Rectangle whose Size = effect("Chaser Control")("Size"), placed at the comp's left edge) and Repeater 1 (Copies = Elements, Position x = Spread, Offset stepped by Box Step Speed over a loop of ceil(compWidth/Spread)+Elements steps). Then set this panel's props; do not rename the effect. Preset stores Box Step Speed 10, Size [100, 50] px, Spread 150, Elements 6. The harvested Size default [960, 540] is the bare pseudo-effect default (comp centre), NOT the preset value: adding the match name alone or resetting Size gives giant boxes. Elements is an integer slider (min 1). Style the boxes via the preset's Fill 1 / Stroke 1.

verified.note: Card status is hidden (a pseudo-effect panel that draws nothing alone; it needs the 'Chasing Line - Boxes' preset on a shape layer), so no gallery frame was rendered and none is listed in gallery/ae/index.json.

cards.name: Color Swirl
cards.summary: Hidden pseudo-effect control panel with a Transition Completion slider and a Final Color swatch, apparently meant to drive a swirl-to-colour transition; no shipped AE preset uses it.
use_for: none in practice: no shipped preset drives it; build a swirl transition with Twirl + Fill instead
avoid: adding it alone changes nothing on screen
orphan control panel: an expression rig must be written by hand to make it do anything

params.name: Transition Completion
params.does: intended 0-100 % progress of the swirl transition (only works if expressions read it)

params.name: Final Color
params.does: intended colour the image swirls into

cards.scripting: Defined in PresetEffects.xml but referenced by no .ffx in the AE 2026 Presets folder (checked by grep), so it is an orphan control panel. Adding it via its match name just gives two inert controls; use it only as a slider/colour container that your own expressions read. Low confidence on its intended look.

cards.name: Corner Reveal
cards.summary: Legacy control panel for a corner reveal: the layer appears as a rectangle growing out of one chosen corner (a horizontal and a vertical Linear Wipe moving together), with a feathered edge. No AE 2026 preset uses this panel any more.
use_for: reveal a document/screenshot from the corner in an explainer
wipe-off of a quote card or photo
graphic transition between B-roll stills
avoid: hard diagonal wipes read as dated PowerPoint if overused
the panel alone does nothing

params.name: Transition Completion
params.does: reveal progress in the shipped Corner Reveal logic: 0 = layer hidden, 100 = fully revealed (the inverse of a native Linear Wipe)

params.name: right (not left)
params.does: checkbox: grow from a right corner instead of a left one

params.name: bottom (not top)
params.does: checkbox: grow from a bottom corner instead of a top one

params.name: Feather
params.does: softness of the wipe edge in pixels

cards.equivalent: Inset (Premiere Wipe transition), or two Linear Wipe effects
cards.scripting: Pseudo effect from Support Files/PresetEffects.xml; it renders NOTHING by itself, and no .ffx in the AE 2026 Presets folder references it any more (checked by byte search), so adding it gives an inert panel. The current preset C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe After Effects 2026/Support Files/Presets/Transitions - Wipes/Corner Reveal.ffx rebuilds the look with plain controls: a Dropdown Menu Control 'Corner' (1 Left Top, 2 Left Bottom, 3 Right Top, 4 Right Bottom), Slider Controls 'Transition Completion' and 'Feather', and two Linear Wipes ('Linear Wipe  - horizontal' angle -90/90, 'Linear Wipe - vertical' angle 0/180) whose completion = linear(TC, 0, 100, 100, 0). Use that preset, or script the two Linear Wipes (ADBE Linear Wipe) directly with Transition Completion keyframed 100 -> 0. A single diagonal Linear Wipe is NOT the same look. Low confidence on how the legacy panel's own controls were wired; the semantics above come from the 2026 preset.

verified.note: Card status is hidden (a legacy pseudo-effect panel no 2026 preset uses, so it draws nothing alone), so no gallery frame was rendered and none is listed in gallery/ae/index.json.

cards.name: Counter Controls
cards.summary: Control panel of the 'Counter Countdown Monospaced' text preset: turns a text layer into a rolling number counter with padding, decimals, locale grouping and optional prefix/suffix text.
use_for: animated statistic in a news/explainer reel (votes, rupees spent, km built)
countdown to an event or result
big-number hook card for a reel
score/tally in an election graphic
avoid: no Indian lakh/crore grouping (only en-US, de-DE, fr-FR formats)
the expressions are keyed to the effect's preset name; renaming or adding it on its own breaks the counter
huge Animate Value with many digits rolls too fast to read: ease the keyframes

params.name: Animate Value
params.does: the number shown (absolute value; sign handled separately); keyframe it to count

params.name: 10x Value Multiplier
params.does: shown number = Animate Value x 10^(value-1); 1 shows Animate Value as-is. Use it for numbers above the 1,000,000 slider limit
params.typical: 1 (the preset ships 2 = x10: always set it)

params.name: Pad Zeros
params.does: minimum integer digits; extra places show as leading zeros (0025)
params.typical: 1 for a stat reveal, 3-4 for a countdown look (preset 4)

params.name: Digits After Decimal
params.does: decimal places shown

params.name: Number Format
params.does: locale separators via Intl.NumberFormat: 1 en-US, 2 de-DE, 3 fr-FR

params.name: Show Original Text
params.does: where the text layer's own source text goes relative to the number: a prefix like '₹' (1) or a suffix like ' crore' (2)
params.typical: 1 for a '₹' prefix, 2 for a ' crore' suffix, 3 none (preset 3)

params.name: Show Group Separators
params.does: checkbox: thousands separators on/off

params.name: Align Group Spacing
params.does: which side stays put when Group Spacing widens the separators (Left/Right/Center)

cards.equivalent: no Premiere effect; use a counter .mogrt or a Source Text expression in AE
cards.scripting: Pseudo effect (expression-control panel) defined in Support Files/PresetEffects.xml; it renders NOTHING by itself. Apply C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe After Effects 2026/Support Files/Presets/Text/Number Counters/Counter Countdown Monospaced.ffx to a TEXT layer (layer.applyPreset(File(...))); it renames the effect 'Counter Countdown Controls' and its Source Text + Character Offset animators reference that name, so never rename it or add the match name alone. Preset keyframes Animate Value 100 -> 0 (the countdown) and stores 10x Value Multiplier 2, Pad Zeros 4, Digits After Decimal 0, Number Format 1, Show Original Text 3, Show Group Separators 0, Align Group Spacing 3: set the multiplier to 1 or every value shows x10. Verified from the expressions: displayed = |Animate Value| x 10^(multiplier-1) (sign shown separately); Animate Value is capped at 1,000,000, so for 45,000 crore in full digits use Animate Value 450000 with multiplier 7. Popups are 1-based (Number Format 1 en-US 1,234,567.01 / 2 de-DE / 3 fr-FR; Show Original Text 1 Before Numbers / 2 After Numbers / 3 Hide). Checkbox = 0/1. For rupees: source text '₹' + Show Original Text 1. With 2 (After Numbers) the digit animator only counts the first Pad Zeros digits, so set Pad Zeros to the final number's digit count (medium confidence). Keep digits out of the source text; use a monospaced font or the digits jitter.

verified.note: Card status is hidden (a pseudo-effect panel that only works through the Counter Countdown preset on a text layer, not on the photo), so no gallery frame was rendered and none is listed in gallery/ae/index.json.
verified.second_opinion: corrected: scripting said the preset stores a static Animate Value (2); the .ffx actually keyframes it 100 -> 0. not_rendered verdict and empty demo_settings are right (hidden panel, no gallery frame)

cards.name: Cracked Tiles
cards.summary: Control panel of the 'Cracked Tiles' image preset: cuts the layer into a grid of Card Wipe cards that shrink apart (thin gaps) and jitter slightly, like a cracked tiled wall.
use_for: 'system is broken' visual behind a satire or scam explainer
fractured still for a trailer hit
stylised background plate for a title
avoid: faces split by tile seams look ugly
Card Wipe is a heavy 3D effect: slow on long clips
the panel alone does nothing

params.name: Tile Cracking
params.does: 0-100 %: shrinks every card from 100 % to 90 % (opening gaps) and raises X/Y/Z position jitter from 0 to 1

params.name: Tiles Across
params.does: Card Wipe Rows AND Columns (both get this value), so tiles keep the layer's aspect ratio

cards.scripting: Pseudo effect (expression-control panel) defined in Support Files/PresetEffects.xml; it renders NOTHING by itself. Apply C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe After Effects 2026/Support Files/Presets/Image - Special Effects/Cracked Tiles.ffx (layer.applyPreset(File(...))), then set this panel. It drives one Card Wipe (APC CardWipeCam): Rows = Columns = Tiles Across, Card Scale = linear(Tile Cracking, 0, 100, 1, 0.9), X/Y/Z Jitter Amount = linear(Tile Cracking, 0, 100, 0, 1); there is no rotation jitter, so the tiles do not tilt. Without the preset, apply Card Wipe directly and set Rows, Columns, Card Scale and the jitter amounts.

verified.note: Card status is hidden (a pseudo-effect panel that draws nothing without the Cracked Tiles preset's Card Wipe), so no gallery frame was rendered and none is listed in gallery/ae/index.json.

use_for: trim black bars or burned-in tickers off sourced news footage
soft-edged inset frame for picture-in-picture
clean edges on scanned documents
avoid: equal crop on all sides only; use Crop/masks for asymmetric trims
the panel alone does nothing

params.name: Crop Amount (per edge)
params.does: percent of width/height removed from EACH edge

params.name: Feather
params.does: edge softness in pixels

cards.scripting: Pseudo effect (expression-control panel) defined in Support Files/PresetEffects.xml; it renders NOTHING by itself. The visible result comes from the companion effects and expressions inside the shipped .ffx preset, so apply the preset (layer.applyPreset(File(...))) and then set this panel's props; adding the match name alone gives an inert slider panel. cards.name: Dissolve - unmelt
cards.summary: Control panel of the 'Dissolve - unmelt' transition preset: the layer fades in from transparent while a turbulent liquid warp eases out to clean (Transition Completion 0 = invisible and fully warped, 100 = clean and opaque).
use_for: dream/flashback transition in a documentary
melt-away of an old headline or photo
surreal reel transition
avoid: looks gimmicky on hard news
distortion smears faces
the panel alone does nothing

params.name: Transition Completion
params.does: reveal progress: drives Solid Composite Source Opacity 0 -> 100 and Turbulent Displace Amount from Maximum Distortion down to 0
params.typical: keyframe 0 -> 100 on the incoming layer (100 -> 0 to melt a layer out)

params.name: Maximum Distortion
params.does: Turbulent Displace Amount at 0 % completion; eased out to 0 at 100 %

cards.scripting: Pseudo effect (expression-control panel) defined in Support Files/PresetEffects.xml; it renders NOTHING by itself. Apply C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe After Effects 2026/Support Files/Presets/Transitions - Dissolves/Dissolve - unmelt.ffx (layer.applyPreset(File(...))), then set this panel. Expressions: Turbulent Displace Amount = easeOut(TC, 0, 100, Maximum Distortion, 0), Size = layer width/5; Solid Composite Source Opacity = linear(TC, 0, 100, 0, 100). So 0 = hidden, 100 = fully visible (the opposite of AE's native Transition Completion). Keyframe over 0.5-1 s on the upper layer of the cut.

verified.note: Card status is hidden (a pseudo-effect panel that draws nothing without the Dissolve - unmelt preset's Turbulent Displace and Solid Composite), so no gallery frame was rendered and none is listed in gallery/ae/index.json.

cards.name: Dissolve Master Control
cards.summary: Shared single-slider control panel used by several dissolve transition presets (vapor, dither, ripple, block dissolves) to drive their progress.
use_for: one keyframed slider to run a vapor/dither/block dissolve between shots
pixel/block dissolve for a tech or glitchy reel
avoid: the panel alone does nothing

params.name: Transition Completion
params.does: reveal progress of whichever dissolve preset added it: 0 = layer hidden, 100 = fully visible
params.typical: keyframe 0 -> 100 on the incoming layer (100 -> 0 to dissolve a layer out)

cards.scripting: Pseudo effect (expression-control panel) defined in Support Files/PresetEffects.xml; it renders NOTHING by itself. Used by C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe After Effects 2026/Support Files/Presets/Transitions - Dissolves/: Block Dissolve - digital and Block Dissolve - scanlines (Block Dissolve completion = 100 - TC, block size grows), Dissolve - dither (Noise Alpha + Solid Composite), Dissolve - ripple (Ripple + Solid Composite), Dissolve - vapor (Fast Box Blur radius height/3 -> 0 + Solid Composite). Every one maps Transition Completion 0 = hidden, 100 = visible, the inverse of AE's native Transition Completion. Apply one preset to the incoming (upper) layer and keyframe this slider 0 -> 100.

cards.name: Drift Over Time
cards.summary: Control panel of the 'Drift Over Time' behavior preset: moves the layer continuously in one direction at a constant speed from its in-point.
use_for: slow pan on a still photo in a documentary
drifting dust/particle or cloud layer
parallax background behind titles
avoid: the layer eventually drifts off frame: oversize or trim it
linear motion with no easing feels mechanical for hero moves
the panel alone does nothing

params.name: Direction
params.does: compass heading of travel: 0 = up, 90 = right, 180 = down, 270 = left (default 135 = down-right)

params.name: Speed (pixels/second)
params.does: drift speed; negative reverses

cards.scripting: Pseudo effect (expression-control panel) defined in Support Files/PresetEffects.xml; it renders NOTHING by itself. Apply C:/Program Files/Adobe/Adobe After Effects 2026/Support Files/Presets/Behaviors/Drift Over Time.ffx (layer.applyPreset(File(...))), then set this panel. It adds a Transform effect (ADBE Geometry2) whose Position expression is [cos(Direction-90), sin(Direction-90)] * Speed * (time - inPoint), an offset from the layer's own place. Direction is an angle with no harvested range. Equivalent by hand: keyframe Position linearly.

cards.name: Face Measurements
cards.summary: Data container written by the AE Face Tracker ('Extract Face Measurements'): per-frame head offset, scale, orientation, eyebrow, eyelid, gaze and mouth values. It draws nothing.
use_for: drive a cartoon/puppet overlay from a presenter's real expressions
trigger a blink or mouth graphic from tracked openness
avoid: values are meaningless until the Face Tracker has run on footage
setting values by hand fakes data and achieves nothing visible

params.name: Face Scale
params.does: tracked head size (%)

params.name: Orientation Y
params.does: head turn angle

params.name: Left Eyelid Openness
params.does: eye openness (%), useful for blink triggers

params.name: Mouth Scale Height
params.does: mouth open amount (%)

params.name: Offset X
params.does: head offset from neutral (%)

cards.scripting: Created by the Tracker panel (Method: Face Tracking (Detailed Features), then Extract Face Measurements) on a footage layer with a mask around the face; needs real face footage. Treat as read-only: link other layers' properties to it with expressions (effect("Face Measurements")("Mouth Scale Height")). Leaves sit inside groups (Face Offset, Face Orientation, Left Eye, Right Eye, Mouth); use the leaf names. No Premiere equivalent.

cards.name: Face Track Points
cards.summary: Data container written by the AE Face Tracker (Detailed Features): keyframed 2D and 3D positions of about 68 facial landmarks plus head position, scale and orientation. It draws nothing.
use_for: pin a blur/mosaic box to a face to anonymise a minor or witness in news footage

avoid: only exists after the Face Tracker runs on footage

cards.scripting: Created by the Tracker panel (Face Tracking (Detailed Features)) on a footage layer with a face mask; needs real face footage. Read-only data for expressions. The 'Face' group (Position, Scale, Orientation X/Y/Z) and the whole 'Face 3D' group are marked INVISIBLE in PresetEffects.xml: they exist and can be read by expressions but do not show in Effect Controls. Every landmark name appears twice: the first is the 2D point (layer pixels), the second ("Left Pupil#2" in the validator, group path 'Face 3D/Left Eye/Left Pupil') is the 3D point; address the 3D ones by group path or property index, never by bare name. No Premiere equivalent (Premiere masks can track faces).

verified.note: Card status is hidden (a read-only Face Tracker data container that draws nothing), so no gallery frame was rendered and none is listed in gallery/ae/index.json.
